newsitem.title: CHINA: China to start annual probes into futures brokers.
newsitem.headline: China to start annual probes into futures brokers.

text.p: China's securities authorities have decided to conduct an annual investigation into all futures brokerages and to close down those that fail the test, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) in a circular ordered local securities authorities to conduct the probes from February 1 to April 30, the newspaper said.

During that period, all futures brokerages must report to the local authorities all details of their operations. The CSRC will have the final say as to which brokerages can continue to operate, the newspaper said.

Brokerages will be closed down if they have insufficient assets to cover debts, if they do not conduct business within six months of receiving approval to begin operations or if they make false statements as part of the annual investigation.
Other grounds for closure include refusal to cooperate with securities authorities in probes into irregular trading and "serious violations of the laws and regulations".
